text:
noah_marketing: Draft blog post uploaded: https://drive.redwoodinference/launch_final_draft.docx. Need quick passes on headline tone, hero image, and lead routing before sending to partner preview.
anya_product: I'll check. Request: add a 2-paragraph technical aside that links to Appendix (benchmarks + methodology) and show 99th-pct latency on the hero chart.
violet_design: Pushed hero crops (hero_live, hero_minimal). I recommend hero_minimal for readability. Need square + wide exports for socials.
sam_ops: For demo signups, we'll pass region and interest tags. Proposed UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q3_2026&utm_region={region}&interest={interest}&ctav={variant}
Mapping: US -> Demo - US, EU -> Demo - EU, APAC -> Demo - APAC (fallback US). I can add webhook to forward signups to HubSpot with those properties.
rachel_legal: Legal notes: avoid absolute superlatives in H1 and headlines (use qualifiers like "up to" or ranges). Must receive partner logo release and sponsor blurb approval before we use partner branding.
partner_acct: We can supply logo + release if we get the sponsor blurb and a 24-hour preview URL. Please send ASAP.
noah_marketing: I'll draft a neutral sponsor sentence and tag partner. Also planning a small CTA AB test: Variant A="Book a private demo" vs Variant B="Schedule a dedicated walkthrough" 50/50.
anya_product: Appendix ETA: 2pm PT with raw csv and scripts, plus a short reproducibility note. I'll tone down numeric claims and reference the appendix.
violet_design: Will queue chart exports once Appendix charts are posted. Need high-res PNG + SVG for the blog and social thumbnails.
sam_ops: I'll provision demo rooms and configure HubSpot routing today. Will include experiment flag in the demo link for CTAv. ETA EOD.
rachel_legal: I'll review Appendix + sponsor blurb when posted; if partner assets are late, we'll publish with text-only mention.
announce-bot: Reminder: proposed embargo lift 2026-05-04 09:00 PT. Partner requests 24-hour preview. Final review tentatively 2026-05-01 16:00 PT: https://meet.redwoodinference/final-launch-review
noah_marketing: Timeline recap: partner assets + release by EOD, Appendix by 2pm PT, legal signoff by 5pm PT. Will post final draft here for a one-hour review window after signoff. Any blocking issues? :thumbsup:
anya_product: :thumbsup:
violet_design: :thumbsup:
sam_ops: :thumbsup:
rachel_legal: :thumbsup: pending assets
partner_acct: We'll aim to send assets by 5pm PT.
noah_marketing: Thanks all  will update the draft in an hour and share the preview link for partner.
